## Problem

Describe the expected and observed behavior.

## Reproduction

Provide the commit, command, minimal configuration, and episode/model ID if relevant.

## Environment

OS, Python, simulator, driver/GPU, and relevant dependency versions.

## Evidence

Include the result status, scoring version, and a short redacted log excerpt. Do not include credentials, private endpoints, or raw request payloads.
